description:
##This is THE essential San Diego tour. You will see many of the great places that make San Diego "America's Finest City". You will also get a small sample of San Diego's culture and diversity!*

This is THE essential San Diego tour. You will see almost all of the greatest sights San Diego has to offer, from the visually stunning Balboa park which is littered with Spanish Renaissance-inspired architecture, over a dozen museums, colorful flower gardens, and a world-renowned outdoor organ pavilion all the way to the always happening Hillcrest, which has a great variety of shops and restaurants, Hillcrest is known to have some of the best food in the county. But best of all you will also get to see Downtown San Diego at its finest, from the Maritime Museum to the Historic Gaslamp Quarter. Downtown San Diego is one of the best places in the world for its diversity and visual appeal. Don’t miss the best places San Diego has to offer on this Must See tour.
